result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers on the sample files.

Three of the queries rest on assumptions I didn't fully test:
- **U5:** I filter on `/assignee`, which works on this file. I did not run the `at :assignee` form below, which I'd expect to also handle issues with no assignee key.
- **U2 and U3:** I only checked that `orders.json` contains one null. I didn't confirm it is an `items` value, so the null-items case is unverified.
- **U9 and U10:** I split the CSV on commas, so a quoted field containing a comma would break them.

U1: `/data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)`
U2: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100`
U3: `filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)`
U4: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0) | distinct | map ~(keyword) | sort ~(/)`
U5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3`
U6: `map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~(/)`
U7: `lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10`
U8: `lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c (/1 | count)}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)`
U9: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | map ~({:c (/1 | lower) :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/p) | avg | mul 100 | round | div 100)`
U10: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "0") | map ~({:n /0 :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)`
U11: `:dp (/defaults/port) | :de (/defaults/enabled) | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :port (/1 | at :port | coalesce dp) :en (/1 | at :enabled | coalesce de)}) | filter ~(/en | ne false) | sort ~(/name) | map ~({:name /name :port /port})`
U12: `sort ~(/ts) | groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(last | /type)`
U13: `lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort ~(/) | join ","`
U14: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count (count) :longest (w | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}`
